title: Suffolk wildfires threaten Ralph Fiennes' house as National Trust launches public appeal over 'total devastation' of vital nature reserve
description: The British actor's property remained inside an exclusion zone on Friday, with access roads shut off by police road blocks.
content:
Actor Ralph Fiennes is among the anxious homeowners waiting to see if their homes have been destroyed in the Suffolk wildfires.

de: Waldbrände in Suffolk bedrohen das Haus von Ralph Fiennes, während der National Trust öffentliche Berufung wegen „völliger Zerstörung“ eines lebenswichtigen Naturschutzgebiets einlegt. Das Anwesen des britischen Schauspielers blieb am Freitag innerhalb einer Sperrzone, wobei die Zufahrtsstraßen durch Straßensperren der Polizei gesperrt waren.
en: Suffolk wildfires threaten Ralph Fiennes' house as National Trust launches public appeal over 'total devastation' of vital nature reserve. The British actor's property remained inside an exclusion zone on Friday, with access roads shut off by police road blocks.
la: Ignium incendium Suffolciae in domo Radulphi Fiennes imminet ac National Trust publicam appellationem inducit super "vastationem totalis" reservationis vitalis. Actoris proprietas Britannica die Veneris intra zonam exclusivam mansit, cum accessu viae viae vigilum clausurae interclusae sunt.

title: Two helicopters collide while battling wildfires (VIDEOS)
description: Two firefighting helicopters collided in midair in Greece, killing two crew members, as hundreds of personnel battled at least 220 wildfires recorded nationwide over the past week, according to the Greek Fire Service.

de: Zwei Hubschrauber kollidieren bei der Bekämpfung von Waldbränden (VIDEOS). Nach Angaben der griechischen Feuerwehr kollidierten zwei Löschhubschrauber in Griechenland in der Luft und töteten zwei Besatzungsmitglieder, während Hunderte von Mitarbeitern in der vergangenen Woche landesweit mindestens 220 Waldbrände bekämpften.
en: Two helicopters collide while battling wildfires (VIDEOS). Two firefighting helicopters collided in midair in Greece, killing two crew members, as hundreds of personnel battled at least 220 wildfires recorded nationwide over the past week, according to the Greek Fire Service.
la: Duo helicoptera dum in wildfires pugnantes collidunt (VIDEOS). Duo pugnae helicopterae in media aere in Graecia conflixerunt, duo membra turba occisorum, cum centum curatorum proeliatorum saltem 220 incendia ignium nationum per hebdomadam relatam, secundum Servitium Graecum.
